info.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash API Reference (Responses API)
info.description:
Complete API reference for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash using the Responses API.

**Model capabilities**:
- Context window: **1,000,000 tokens** (1M)
- Maximum output: **524,288 tokens** (512K); **131,072 tokens** (128K) recommended, including reasoning tokens
- Reasoning: always enabled; adjust depth with `reasoning.effort`, which defaults to `max`
- Multimodal input: text, images, and video
- Tool calling: Function Calling
- Context caching: matching prefixes are cached automatically and billed at the cache-hit rate

**Stateless requests**: Responses are not stored. Include the complete conversation history with each request.

post.description:
- Call MiniMax-M3.1-Flash using the OpenAI Responses protocol
- **Input**: `input` accepts plain text or an array of input items (messages, function calls, and function results)
- **Multimodal input**: combine `input_text`, `input_image`, and `input_video` blocks in message `content`
- **System instructions**: use `instructions`, equivalent to an initial system message
- **Reasoning**: always enabled; adjust depth with `reasoning.effort`. Reasoning is returned as `reasoning` output items
- **Streaming**: semantic SSE events ending with `response.completed`, without a `[DONE]` marker
- **Tool calling**: Function Calling
- **Context caching**: matching prefixes are cached automatically; cached tokens are reported in `usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens`

**Stateless requests**: Responses are not stored and `previous_response_id` is not supported. For each turn, append every item from the previous `output` to `input` in its original order, preserving all fields, including `content`, `summary`, and `encrypted_content` in reasoning items. After executing a tool, append a `function_call_output` item with the same `call_id` as the function call.

**Streaming events**: `response.created`, `response.in_progress`, `response.output_item.added`, `response.content_part.added`, `response.reasoning_text.delta` / `response.reasoning_text.done`, `response.output_text.delta` / `response.output_text.done`, `response.content_part.done`, and `response.output_item.done`, ending with `response.completed`. Each event includes a `sequence_number` for ordering.

bearerAuth.description:
All APIs require Bearer Token authentication

**Get API Key**:

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header**:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

input.description:
Model input.

- **String**: treated as a single `user` message
- **Array**: input items of type `message`, `function_call`, `function_call_output`, or `reasoning`

**Multimodal input**: combine `input_text`, `input_image`, and `input_video` blocks in message `content`.

**Conversation history**: requests are stateless. Include the complete history in the array for each turn.

instructions.description: System-level instructions, equivalent to a system message inserted at the very front; used to set the role, tone and output constraints.
instructions.example: You are a technical documentation assistant. Keep your answers concise.

stream.description:
Whether to stream the response.

- `false` (default): return the complete response at once
- `true`: send semantic SSE events ending with `response.completed`, without a `[DONE]` marker

max_output_tokens.description:
Maximum output tokens, **including reasoning and the final answer**.

- Recommended: **131,072** (128K); maximum: **524,288** (512K)
- A small budget may be exhausted during reasoning, resulting in `status: "incomplete"` without a `message` output item

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash always uses reasoning, returned as `reasoning` output items. Reasoning tokens count toward the output budget and are billed at the output rate.

effort.description: Reasoning depth. Defaults to `max`. Higher levels typically increase reasoning token usage and response time.

tools.description: Tools available to the model. Only `function` tools are supported. Execute the function on the client and return its result as a `function_call_output` input item.

tool_choice.description: Tool selection strategy. Only `auto` is supported; the model decides whether to call a tool.

text.description: Text output format configuration. `format.type` only supports `text`.

metadata.description: Request metadata. Keys and values must be strings.

InputItem.title: Input item
InputItem.description: Input item: a message, reasoning history, function call, or function result.

MessageItem.title: Message item
MessageItem.description: A conversation message. Preserve every returned field when sending assistant history.

id.description: Output item ID. Preserve it in conversation history.

status.description: Output item status. Preserve it in conversation history.

role.description: Message role, used only with `type: message`. `developer` is treated as `system`.

content.description:
Message content, used only for `type: message`. Accepts plain text or an array of content blocks.

**Content block types**:
- `input_text`: text in the `text` field
- `input_image`: image in the `image_url` field
- `input_video`: video in the `video_url` field
- `output_text`: text from an assistant message in conversation history

Maximum request body size: 64 MB.

ReasoningItem.title: Reasoning item
ReasoningItem.description: Reasoning returned in the previous turn. Preserve the complete item, including `id`, `status`, `summary`, `content`, and `encrypted_content`, when continuing the conversation.

id.description: Output item ID. Preserve it in conversation history.

status.description: Output item status. Preserve it in conversation history.

summary.description: Reasoning summary. Preserve it unchanged when passing conversation history.

content.description: Reasoning content blocks. Preserve them in conversation history.

encrypted_content.description: Opaque reasoning data. Preserve it in conversation history.

FunctionCallItem.title: Function call item
FunctionCallItem.description: A function call returned by the model, paired with a `function_call_output` item through `call_id`.

id.description: Output item ID. Preserve it in conversation history.

status.description: Output item status. Preserve it in conversation history.

call_id.description: Function call identifier; `function_call` and `function_call_output` are paired through it.

name.description: Name of the called function, used only with `type: function_call`.

arguments.description: Function call arguments as a JSON string, used only with `type: function_call`.

FunctionCallOutputItem.title: Function result item
FunctionCallOutputItem.description: The result of a function executed by the client, paired with its function call through `call_id`.

call_id.description: Function call identifier; `function_call` and `function_call_output` are paired through it.

output.description: Function execution result, used only with `type: function_call_output`.

image_url.description: Image input for `type: input_image`. Accepts a URL / Base64 data URL string, or an object such as `{"url": "...", "detail": "low | default | high"}` to control resolution. Higher resolution increases detail and token usage. Supports JPEG / PNG / GIF / WEBP, up to 10 MB per image.

url.description: Image URL or Base64 data URL.

video_url.description: Video input for `type: input_video`. Accepts a URL / Base64 data URL string, or an object with `url`, `fps`, `detail`, and `max_long_side_pixel`. `fps` is the frame sampling rate, with a default of 1 and a range of [0.2, 5]. Lower rates use fewer tokens. Supports MP4 / AVI / MOV / MKV, up to 50 MB for URL / Base64 input. Use an `mm_file://{file_id}` reference for larger videos.

url.description: Video URL, Base64 data URL, or `mm_file://{file_id}` reference.

max_long_side_pixel.description: Maximum length of a video frame's longest side, in pixels.

description.description: Function description to help the model decide when to call it.
description.example: Get the current stock level for a product.

parameters.description: Parameter definition in JSON Schema format.

ResponsesResponse.description: Responses API response object. In addition to the fields below, the response includes the request configuration, such as `tools`, `tool_choice`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `text`, `reasoning`, and `max_output_tokens`.

created_at.description: Creation time as a Unix timestamp (seconds)

status.description:
Response status.

- `completed`: generation completed
- `incomplete`: generation was truncated; see `incomplete_details`
- `failed`: generation failed; see `error`

model.description: ID of the model that actually generated this response

output.description:
Output items in generation order:

- `reasoning`: reasoning content, with an ID such as `<id>_rs`, `content` (`reasoning_text` blocks), `summary` (an empty array), and `encrypted_content`
- `message`: final answer, with an ID such as `<id>_msg` and `content` (`output_text` blocks)
- `function_call`: a function call, with an ID such as `<id>_fc_<index>`, `call_id`, `name`, and `arguments`. Execute it on the client and return a `function_call_output` item

output_text.description: Convenience field containing all `output_text` blocks concatenated. `null` when there is no text output.

incomplete_details.description: Truncation details, or `null` if generation was not truncated. `reason` is `max_output_tokens` (output limit reached) or `content_filter` (content safety).

Usage.description: Token usage statistics, including caching and reasoning details.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens, including cached tokens.

cached_tokens.description:
Number of cached input tokens.

Cached tokens are billed at the cache-hit rate. Uncached tokens (`input_tokens - cached_tokens`) are billed at the standard input rate.

output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens (including the thinking portion)
